يضطرم (form VIII)
# يَضْطَرِمُ (yaḍṭarimu) /jadˤ.tˤa.ri.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# يَضْطَرِمَ (yaḍṭarima) /jadˤ.tˤa.ri.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
# يَضْطَرِمْ (yaḍṭarim) /jadˤ.tˤa.rim/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِضْطَرَمَ (iḍṭarama)
